overview: AnimateDiff is the classic motion-module approach to text-to-video: it animates existing Stable Diffusion image models by inserting a trained temporal module, rather than training a video model from scratch. Validated with the released checkpoints: WorldFoundry reproduces the official RealisticVision `scripts.animate` demo output exactly. Aliases: animate-diff and animate_diff.
overviewZh: AnimateDiff 是经典的「运动模块」式文生视频方法：通过在现成的 Stable Diffusion 图像模型中插入训练好的时序模块来让静态模型动起来，而不是从头训练视频模型。已用发布的 checkpoint 验证：WorldFoundry 的输出与官方 RealisticVision `scripts.animate` demo 完全一致。别名：animate-diff、animate_diff。
architecture: A legacy U-Net latent diffusion backbone (Stable Diffusion v1.5) plus AnimateDiff's temporal motion module. It uses the guoyww/animatediff motion modules, the guoyww/animatediff_t2i_backups T2I weights, stable-diffusion-v1-5, and the CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder.
architectureZh: 基座为旧式 U-Net 潜空间扩散模型（Stable Diffusion v1.5），叠加 AnimateDiff 的时序运动模块。使用 guoyww/animatediff 运动模块、guoyww/animatediff_t2i_backups T2I 权重、stable-diffusion-v1-5 与 CLIP ViT-L/14 文本编码器。
usageNotes: A good first video route, since it reproduces the official demo exactly. CLI, Studio, and API runs all use the unified environment `worldfoundry-unified-cu128`; a CUDA GPU is required.
usageNotesZh: 输出与官方 demo 完全一致，适合作为入门视频生成路径。CLI、Studio 与 API 均在统一环境 `worldfoundry-unified-cu128` 中运行；需要 CUDA GPU。

paper.title: Astra: General Interactive World Model with Autoregressive Denoising
paper.abstract: Recent advances in diffusion transformers have empowered video generation models to generate high-quality video clips from texts or images. However, world models with the ability to predict long-horizon futures from past observations and actions remain underexplored, especially for general-purpose scenarios and various forms of actions. To bridge this gap, we introduce Astra, an interactive general world model that generates real-world futures for diverse scenarios (e.g., autonomous driving, robot grasping) with precise action interactions (e.g., camera motion, robot action). We propose an autoregressive denoising architecture and use temporal causal attention to aggregate past observations and support streaming outputs. We use a noise-augmented history memory to avoid over-reliance on past frames to balance responsiveness with temporal coherence. For precise action control, we introduce

The prior single-GPU OOM came from forcing Qwen3 dense attention through SDPBackend.MATH; Qwen3 dense inference now uses SDPBackend.EFFICIENT_ATTENTION for this profile.
Inference-only environment for the flattened Being-H0.5 runtime. It does not require datasets, trainers, DeepSpeed, or an editable source checkout.

architecture: Per the publication (arXiv 2404.02101), camera poses are encoded as Plücker embeddings and injected through a trainable camera encoder attached to a frozen video diffusion base (AnimateDiff in the official release).

overview: Causal-Forcing distills bidirectional video diffusion into a causal, autoregressive generator — including Causal-Forcing++ few-step variants — so video can be generated chunk by chunk or frame by frame. WorldFoundry serves every released student as a native diffusion recipe, with the chunk-wise student as the default and the frame-wise and ++ students selected by variant.
overviewZh: Causal-Forcing 把双向视频扩散蒸馏为因果自回归生成器——包括 Causal-Forcing++ 少步 variant——使视频可以逐 chunk 或逐帧生成。WorldFoundry 以原生扩散 recipe 提供全部已发布的学生模型，默认是 chunk-wise 学生，frame-wise 与 ++ 学生通过 variant 选择。
architecture: Per the paper (arXiv 2602.02214), a Wan2.1-based teacher is distilled into causal students with chunk-wise or frame-wise attention; the ++ variants push to 1-2 step sampling. Recorded checkpoints include chunk-wise plus frame-wise and two ++ few-step variants under zhuhz22/Causal-Forcing.
architectureZh: 按论文（arXiv 2602.02214），基于 Wan2.1 的教师被蒸馏为 chunk-wise 或 frame-wise 注意力的因果学生；++ variant 进一步压缩到 1-2 步采样。记录的 checkpoint 包括 chunk-wise，以及 zhuhz22/Causal-Forcing 下的 frame-wise 与两个 ++ 少步 variant。
usageNotes: Defaults follow the official CLI (480x832, 81 frames, guidance 1.0, 16 fps) with each variant's released step count. Only the frame-wise student accepts an input image, which becomes the first latent frame.
usageNotesZh: 默认值沿用官方 CLI（480x832、81 帧、guidance 1.0、16 fps），步数取各 variant 发布的步数。只有 frame-wise 学生接受输入图像，图像成为第一个潜帧。

paper.title: Causal Forcing: Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation Done Right for High-Quality Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
paper.abstract: To achieve real-time interactive video generation, current methods distill pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into few-step autoregressive (AR) models, facing an architectural gap when full attention is replaced by causal attention. However, existing approaches do not bridge this gap theoretically. They initialize the AR student via ODE distillation, which requires frame-level injectivity, where each noisy frame must map to a unique clean frame under the PF-ODE of an AR teacher. Distilling an AR student from a bidirectional teacher violates this condition, preventing recovery of the teacher's flow map and instead inducing a conditional-expectation solution, which degrades performance. To address this issue, we propose Causal Forcing, which uses an autoregressive teacher for ODE initialization to bridge the architectural gap, and then applies the same DMD procedure as in Self

overview: CogVideoX is Zhipu AI's open video generation family, one of the most widely used open T2V/I2V baselines. It ships three runnable variants — 2B text-to-video, 5B text-to-video, and 5B image-to-video. Weights load natively from Hugging Face (THUDM/CogVideoX-5b) or from a local mirror via model_path.
overviewZh: CogVideoX 是智谱 AI 的开源视频生成系列，也是使用最广的开源文生/图生视频基线之一。它提供三个可运行 variant——2B 文生视频、5B 文生视频、5B 图生视频。权重可从 Hugging Face 原生加载（THUDM/CogVideoX-5b），也可用 model_path 指向本地镜像。
architecture: CogVideoX uses a diffusion transformer over a 3D causal VAE latent space with an expert transformer conditioning design (per the upstream publication). T2V exposes num_inference_steps, num_frames, height, width, and fps; I2V adds guidance_scale.
architectureZh: CogVideoX 采用 3D 因果 VAE 潜空间上的扩散 Transformer，并使用专家 Transformer 条件设计（见上游论文）。T2V 暴露 num_inference_steps、num_frames、height、width、fps，I2V 额外暴露 guidance_scale。

usageNotesZh: 按大小与任务选 variant：2B T2V 适合快速迭代，5B T2V 追求质量，5B I2V 用于让图片动起来。

overviewZh: Depth Any Panoramas（DAP）是影石 Insta360 面向全景图像的米制深度估计器，从单张等距柱状投影图得到完整 360° 深度。WorldFoundry 将它作为几何先验运行，使用 Insta360-Research/DAP-weights checkpoint。
architecture: A Depth-Anything-family model adapted to panoramic inputs and metric output: a DINOv3-Large backbone with a DPT-style decoder, a dense metric depth head, and a range-mask head for pixels beyond a confident distance.

overview: DIAMOND (DIffusion As a Model Of eNvironment Dreams) trains reinforcement-learning agents entirely inside a diffusion world model, with released Atari agents and a playable CS:GO world model (NeurIPS 2024). WorldFoundry runs the official play and inference stack locally through the diamond-atari and diamond-csgo variants.
overviewZh: DIAMOND（DIffusion As a Model Of eNvironment Dreams）让强化学习智能体完全在扩散世界模型内训练，官方发布了 Atari 智能体与可游玩的 CS:GO 世界模型（NeurIPS 2024）。WorldFoundry 通过 diamond-atari 与 diamond-csgo 两个 variant 在本地运行官方 play 与推理栈。
architecture: Per the publication, frame prediction uses an EDM-style diffusion model over recent frames and actions, keeping visual detail that latent world models lose. The upstream code is MIT-licensed.
architectureZh: 按论文，帧预测使用基于近期帧与动作的 EDM 式扩散模型，保留了潜空间世界模型会丢失的视觉细节。上游代码采用 MIT 许可。
usageNotes: Use DIAMONDPipeline(pretrained=True, pretrained_game=...) for Atari or DIAMONDCsgoPipeline for CS:GO; then execute=True and headless_steps. Inputs come from real Atari initialization or the released CS:GO spawn. Prompt/image/video are not required.
usageNotesZh: Atari 使用 DIAMONDPipeline(pretrained=True, pretrained_game=...)；CS:GO 使用 DIAMONDCsgoPipeline。调用时设置 execute=True 与 headless_steps。输入来自真实 Atari 初始化或官方 CS:GO spawn，无需 prompt/image/video。
highlightsZh: 公开的 Hugging Face 权重
limitations: Game-specific world models, not general text-to-video.
Validation covers short rollouts. Long-horizon physics, reward accuracy and general game success remain unverified.
CS:GO requires local checkpoint/config/spawn assets; runtime network downloads are disabled.
limitationsZh: 游戏专用世界模型，不是通用文生视频模型。
仅验证短程推理；长程物理、奖励准确率和通关效果尚未验证。
CS:GO 需要本地 checkpoint/config/spawn，推理时禁用网络下载。

paper.title: FantasyWorld: Geometry-Consistent World Modeling via Unified Video and 3D Prediction
paper.abstract: High-quality 3D world models are pivotal for embodied intelligence and Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), underpinning applications such as AR/VR content creation and robotic navigation. Despite the established strong imaginative priors, current video foundation models lack explicit 3D grounding capabilities, thus being limited in both spatial consistency and their utility for downstream 3D reasoning tasks. In this work, we present FantasyWorld, a geometry-enhanced framework that augments frozen video foundation models with a trainable geometric branch, enabling joint modeling of video latents and an implicit 3D field in a single forward pass. Our approach introduces cross-branch supervision, where geometry cues guide video generation and video priors regularize 3D prediction, thus yielding consistent and generalizable 3D-aware video representations. paper.title: FlashWorld: High-quality 3D Scene Generation within Seconds
paper.abstract: We propose FlashWorld, a generative model that produces 3D scenes from a single image or text prompt in seconds, 10~100$\times$ faster than previous works while possessing superior rendering quality. Our approach shifts from the conventional multi-view-oriented (MV-oriented) paradigm, which generates multi-view images for subsequent 3D reconstruction, to a 3D-oriented approach where the model directly produces 3D Gaussian representations during multi-view generation. While ensuring 3D consistency, 3D-oriented method typically suffers poor visual quality. FlashWorld includes a dual-mode pre-training phase followed by a cross-mode post-training phase, effectively integrating the strengths of both paradigms. Specifically, leveraging the prior from a video diffusion model, we first pre-train a dual-mode multi-view diffusion model, which jointly supports MV-oriented and 3D-oriented generation

inputs.default: A grand natural scene unfolds in an open landscape, beginning with a wide, distant view of a massive waterfall cascading down a towering cliff that dominates the frame, its immense scale emphasized by the surrounding rock formations and mist-filled air. From the cliff's edge, enormous volumes of water surge downward in continuous streams, breaking into layered sheets and turbulent ribbons as gravity accelerates the flow, while countless fine droplets are torn from the main body of water and dispersed into the air, forming a drifting veil of mist that catches the sunlight and shimmers faintly. The waterfall's surface exhibits complex motion, with faster central currents plunging straight down and thinner side streams clinging briefly to the rock face before peeling away, creating visible variations in speed, thickness, and texture. As the camera slowly advances forward and downward, the perspective tightens, bringing the lower section of the waterfall into clearer view, where the falling water collides violently with the surface below, generating bursts of white foam and outward-splashing sprays. The camera continues to move closer, transitioning into a medium and then near-field view of the plunge pool at the base of the waterfall, revealing a circular water basin whose surface churns constantly under the impact. Within the pool, swirling currents rotate in overlapping patterns, with darker, deeper green-blue water visible beneath the frothy white surface, and concentric ripples propagate outward toward the rocky edges. Individual droplets and splashes are now discernible, arcing briefly through the air before rejoining the pool, while fine mist rises continuously and drifts laterally with subtle air movement. Wet rock surfaces around the pool glisten under natural light, reflecting soft highlights that shift with the camera's motion. Throughout the shot, the camera movement remains smooth and deliberate, steadily closing the distance from the monumental wide shot to an intimate, detailed view of the water's surface, emphasizing the physical continuity of flowing water, gravity-driven motion, and the dynamic interaction between falling streams, airborne droplets, and the turbulent pool below.

recipes.summary: LingBot-World is Robbyant's camera-controlled world video model. Validated with the base-cam checkpoint on the official camera-control demo: the pipeline generates all 161 frames at 832x464 and 16 fps with 70 denoising steps, and a four-A1…

notes: LingBotPipeline wraps the in-tree LingBot world runtime.
The official base-cam recipe uses eight GPUs with both DiT/T5 FSDP and Ulysses sequence parallelism.
Workspace also supports a four-GPU compact topology; both 4 and 8 divide the model's 40 attention heads.

On four A100 80GB GPUs, Workspace adapts the catalog default to T5 FSDP, replicated/offloaded DiTs, and Ulysses size 4. This exact topology completed all 70 denoising steps and produced a coherent 161-frame artifact on 2026-07-28.

A checkpoint-backed single-GPU full-quality run completed on 2026-07-28 with the official 161-frame, 70-step, 399360-pixel-area base-cam settings; all 161 frames decoded at 832x464 and 16 FPS with non-static, non-black content.

The public lingbot-world binding also validated the independent Fast weights with runtime_variant=fast and fast_model_path in the dedicated environment. The 21-frame output decoded at 544x720 and 16 FPS with changing content; longer Fast rollouts and camera adherence were not measured. Fast frame counts must be 12n-3 (9, 21, 33, ...) because upstream chunks three latent frames.
Runtime dependencies are declared in-tree; environment creation does not read an external LingBot repository checkout.
LingBot-World act2cam parity requires the dedicated official environment with flash-attn; the unified env produced near-black act2cam videos on the upstream examples/05 demo.
Exact torch and flash-attn pins intentionally keep this model out of unified runtime routing.

overview: Metric3D recovers metric-scale depth from a single image by normalizing images into a canonical camera space, which lets one model generalize across cameras. WorldFoundry uses it as a metric-depth prior, and it is the default metric-depth model in the ViPE SLAM configuration.
overviewZh: Metric3D 通过把图像归一化到规范相机空间，从单张图像恢复米制尺度深度，使单一模型能够跨相机泛化。WorldFoundry 将其用作米制深度先验，它也是 ViPE SLAM 配置中的默认米制深度模型。
architecture: Per the upstream publication (ICCV 2023), a canonical-camera transformation resolves the metric ambiguity of single-image depth. The checkpoint is JUGGHM/Metric3D under a bsd-2-clause license.
architectureZh: 按上游论文（ICCV 2023），规范相机变换消解了单图深度的米制歧义。checkpoint 为 JUGGHM/Metric3D，许可 bsd-2-clause。
usageNotes: Pass one image as input_path and, when known, its focal_length; the run writes the depth prediction to metric3d-prior.npz.
usageNotesZh: 通过 input_path 传入一张图像，已知时同时传入 focal_length；运行后深度预测写入 metric3d-prior.npz。
highlightsZh: 公开的 Hugging Face 权重
limitations: Metric accuracy depends on camera-intrinsics quality; wrong intrinsics degrade the scale.
Single-image prior: it does not enforce temporal consistency across video frames.
limitationsZh: 米制精度依赖相机内参质量；内参错误会破坏尺度。
单帧先验：不保证视频帧间的时序一致性。

overviewZh: MolmoAct2 是 AI2 的第二代动作推理模型，Apache-2.0 checkpoint 阵容齐全：base、Think（深度推理）、DROID（Franka）、双臂 YAM、SO100/101 与 LIBERO。WorldFoundry 将官方 DROID/YAM predict_action 契约作为 action_trace pipeline 运行，无需外部源码检出。
architecture: MolmoAct2 builds on the Molmo open VLM line with action-reasoning heads; the Think variant adds depth-based reasoning before acting. The DROID, YAM, SO100, LIBERO, and Think-LIBERO variants each run their own checkpoint and return an action trace.
architectureZh: MolmoAct2 基于 Molmo 开放 VLM 线并加动作推理头；Think 变体在行动前增加基于深度的推理。DROID、YAM、SO100、LIBERO 与 Think-LIBERO 变体各自加载对应 checkpoint 并返回动作轨迹。
usageNotes: Pick the checkpoint per embodiment: DROID for Franka arms, BimanualYAM for dual-arm YAM, SO100_101 for SO-ARM, LIBERO/Think-LIBERO for simulation. Camera and state inputs differ by variant: DROID uses external_cam, external_cam_2, and wrist_cam with an 8-D state; YAM uses top_cam, left_cam, and right_cam with a 14-D state; SO100/SO101 uses top_cam and side_cam with a 6-D state; LIBERO and Think-LIBERO use agentview and wrist RGB.
usageNotesZh: 按本体选择 checkpoint：Franka 机械臂用 DROID，双臂 YAM 用 BimanualYAM，SO-ARM 用 SO100_101，仿真用 LIBERO/Think-LIBERO。各变体的相机与状态输入不同：DROID 使用 external_cam、external_cam_2、wrist_cam 与 8 维状态；YAM 使用 top_cam、left_cam、right_cam 与 14 维状态；SO100/SO101 使用 top_cam、side_cam 与 6 维状态；LIBERO 与 Think-LIBERO 使用 agentview 与腕部 RGB。

paper.title: NeoVerse: Enhancing 4D World Model with in-the-wild Monocular Videos
paper.abstract: In this paper, we propose NeoVerse, a versatile 4D world model that is capable of 4D reconstruction, novel-trajectory video generation, and rich downstream applications. We first identify a common limitation of scalability in current 4D world modeling methods, caused either by expensive and specialized multi-view 4D data or by cumbersome training pre-processing. In contrast, our NeoVerse is built upon a core philosophy that makes the full pipeline scalable to diverse in-the-wild monocular videos. Specifically, NeoVerse features pose-free feed-forward 4D reconstruction, online monocular degradation pattern simulation, and other well-aligned techniques. These designs empower NeoVerse with versatility and generalization to various domains. Meanwhile, NeoVerse achieves state-of-the-art performance in standard reconstruction and generation benchmarks. paper.title: ReCamMaster: Camera-Controlled Generative Rendering from A Single Video
paper.abstract: Camera control has been actively studied in text or image conditioned video generation tasks. However, altering camera trajectories of a given video remains under-explored, despite its importance in the field of video creation. It is non-trivial due to the extra constraints of maintaining multiple-frame appearance and dynamic synchronization. To address this, we present ReCamMaster, a camera-controlled generative video re-rendering framework that reproduces the dynamic scene of an input video at novel camera trajectories. The core innovation lies in harnessing the generative capabilities of pre-trained text-to-video models through a simple yet powerful video conditioning mechanism--its capability is often overlooked in current research. paper.title: SCOPE: Simulating Cross-game Operations in Playable Environments for FPS World Models
paper.abstract: Interactive world models for first-person shooter (FPS) games must resolve high-frequency overlapping control signals at every frame without disrupting unaffected regions. Existing methods inject actions globally and train on single titles, failing under dense FPS inputs. We observe that FPS actions are spatially selective: discrete events such as firing or reloading affect only a localized region around the weapon (the scope), while continuous camera and movement signals govern stable surroundings. We propose SCOPE, which inserts a conditioning module into each transformer block of a pretrained video diffusion model. It reshapes features into per-pixel temporal sequences so that each position computes its action response from local visual content. This separates in-scope effects from out-of-scope generation without segmentation labels. We also introduce CrossFPS, the first multi-game FP

overviewZh: Self-Forcing 弥合了自回归视频扩散的训练-推理差距：在训练时模拟推理过程——让每帧以自己先前生成的帧为条件——从而在单卡上实现实时流式文生视频（arXiv 2506.08009）。WorldFoundry 以原生扩散 recipe 提供离线生成与实时流式，在注入官方噪声的条件下与官方推理脚本逐位一致。
architecture: The causal Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B generator (gdhe17/Self-Forcing, self_forcing_dmd.pt) denoises three-latent-frame blocks in four distilled x0 steps at timesteps 1000, 750, 500 and 250 on the shift-5 flow calendar, then commits each clean block to a 21-latent-frame KV cache at timestep 0. The autoregressive-window runner owns the rollout; the Wan2.1 umT5 encoder conditions it and the bf16 Wan2.1 VAE decodes the result, as one clip or chunk by chunk.

paper.title: Self Forcing: Bridging the Train-Test Gap in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: We introduce Self Forcing, a novel training paradigm for autoregressive video diffusion models. It addresses the longstanding issue of exposure bias, where models trained on ground-truth context must generate sequences conditioned on their own imperfect outputs during inference. Unlike prior methods that denoise future frames based on ground-truth context frames, Self Forcing conditions each frame's generation on previously self-generated outputs by performing autoregressive rollout with key-value (KV) caching during training. This strategy enables supervision through a holistic loss at the video level that directly evaluates the quality of the entire generated sequence, rather than relying solely on traditional frame-wise objectives. To ensure training efficiency, we employ a few-step diffusion model along with a stochastic gradient truncation strategy, effectively balancing computation

overview: Show-o (Xie et al., Show Lab at NUS with ByteDance, arXiv 2408.12528) is a single 1.3B transformer that unifies multimodal understanding and generation. It is initialized from Phi-1.5 and, unlike systems that attach a separate diffusion expert to an MLLM, uses one set of weights for both.

Text is discrete tokens modeled autoregressively (next-token prediction). Images are MAGVIT-v2 lookup-free tokens — a 256×256 frame becomes a 16×16 grid from an 8,192-entry codebook — then generated by MaskGIT-style discrete diffusion (mask-token prediction) with full attention. Omni-attention is causal on text and bidirectional on image tokens. The LLM itself encodes the text condition, so there is no extra T5/CLIP text encoder.

The same checkpoint, in the paper, does VQA and captioning, text-to-image, and text-guided inpainting or extrapolation without extra finetuning, plus mixed-modality sequences. Default generation numbers use 1.3B parameters and about 35M image-text pairs (MSCOCO FID-30K 9.24), close to a LLaVA-v1.5-Phi-1.5 understanding-only baseline. WorldFoundry runs text-to-image only.
overviewZh: Show-o（Xie 等，新加坡国立大学 Show Lab 与 ByteDance，arXiv 2408.12528）是一个 1.3B 的单一 Transformer，把多模态理解与生成放在同一套权重里。它从 Phi-1.5 初始化，而不是把独立扩散专家接到 MLLM 上。

文本是离散 token，用自回归 next-token prediction；图像经 MAGVIT-v2 无查找量化，256×256 变成 16×16、码本 8,192，再用 MaskGIT 式离散扩散（mask-token prediction）和全注意力生成。Omni-attention 对文本因果、对图像 token 双向。文本条件由 LLM 自己编码，没有额外的 T5/CLIP 文本编码器。
论文中同一套权重可做 VQA/配文、文生图，以及无需额外微调的文本引导补全与外推，也支持混合模态序列。默认生成数字是 1.3B 参数、约 3500 万图文对（MSCOCO FID-30K 9.24），接近只做理解的 LLaVA-v1.5-Phi-1.5 基线。WorldFoundry 仅运行文生图。
architecture: The transformer is Phi-1.5 with QK-Norm on every attention layer. The embedding table grows by 8,192 learnable image-token rows. A unified prompt wraps the sequence with task markers [MMU] / [T2I], text bounds [SOT]/[EOT], and image bounds [SOI]/[EOI]. Training mixes mask-token prediction and next-token prediction (L_MTP + α L_NTP). Generation starts from all [MASK] tokens and iteratively unmasks over T steps — about 20× fewer steps than autoregressive image decoding; the in-tree runtime defaults to 256 px, CFG 3.0, and 18 steps.

Image I/O uses the MAGVIT-v2 VQ tokenizer (showlab/magvitv2). The paper also studies continuous MAGVIT or CLIP-ViT features for understanding (Show-o† / Show-o‡); the released default weights use discrete tokens for both understanding and generation. WorldFoundry takes mode, prompt, and image inputs and loads microsoft/phi-1_5 with showlab/show-o.
architectureZh: Transformer 是带逐层 QK-Norm 的 Phi-1.5，词表额外增加 8,192 个可学习图像 token。统一 prompt 用 [MMU]/[T2I] 标明任务，用 [SOT]/[EOT]、[SOI]/[EOI] 框住文本与图像。训练同时做 mask-token prediction 与 next-token prediction（L_MTP + α L_NTP）。生成从全 [MASK] 开始、按 T 步逐步揭开，步数大约是自回归解码图像的 1/20；树内运行时默认 256 像素、CFG 3.0、18 步。
图像编解码用 MAGVIT-v2 VQ（showlab/magvitv2）。论文还试过把 MAGVIT 或 CLIP-ViT 连续特征用于理解（Show-o† / Show-o‡）；发布的默认权重对理解与生成都用离散 token。WorldFoundry 接受 mode、prompt 与 image 输入，加载 microsoft/phi-1_5 与 showlab/show-o。
usageNotes: WorldFoundry runs T2I only — set mode accordingly and expect a generated_image artifact. Paper-default resolution is 256; the wrapper uses classifier-free guidance (default 3.0) and 18 discrete-diffusion steps. Weights are MIT at showlab/show-o, with showlab/magvitv2 (MAGVIT-v2) and microsoft/phi-1_5 as companion weights.
usageNotesZh: WorldFoundry 仅运行 T2I，请相应设置 mode，预期产物为 generated_image。论文默认分辨率 256；封装使用 classifier-free guidance（默认 3.0）和 18 步离散扩散。权重为 MIT，位于 showlab/show-o，配套权重为 showlab/magvitv2（MAGVIT-v2）与 microsoft/phi-1_5。

paper.title: Show-o: One Single Transformer to Unify Multimodal Understanding and Generation
paper.abstract: We present a unified transformer, i.e., Show-o, that unifies multimodal understanding and generation. Unlike fully autoregressive models, Show-o unifies autoregressive and (discrete) diffusion modeling to adaptively handle inputs and outputs of various and mixed modalities. The unified model flexibly supports a wide range of vision-language tasks including visual question-answering, text-to-image generation, text-guided inpainting/extrapolation, and mixed-modality generation. Across various benchmarks, it demonstrates comparable or superior performance to existing individual models with an equivalent or larger number of parameters tailored for understanding or generation. This significantly highlights its potential as a next-generation foundation model. Code and models are released at https://github.com/showlab/Show-o.

overviewZh: VMem 是带「面元索引视图记忆」的交互式视频场景生成模型：当你在场景中游走时，它记住哪些表面曾从哪些视角被看到，使新视角与历史保持一致。已用发布的 VMem 与 CUT3R checkpoint 验证：树内 pipeline 复现了官方导航 demo。
architecture: VMem indexes past views by surface elements (surfels) and retrieves only the relevant ones to condition generation of the next view (per the publication, arXiv 2506.18903). It uses CUT3R as its geometry backbone.
architectureZh: VMem 以面元（surfel）索引历史视图，检索相关视图作为下一视角生成的条件（见论文 arXiv 2506.18903）。它以 CUT3R 为几何主干。

paper.title: VMem: Consistent Interactive Video Scene Generation with Surfel-Indexed View Memory
paper.abstract: We propose a novel memory module for building video generators capable of interactively exploring environments. Previous approaches have achieved similar results either by out-painting 2D views of a scene while incrementally reconstructing its 3D geometry-which quickly accumulates errors-or by using video generators with a short context window, which struggle to maintain scene coherence over the long term. To address these limitations, we introduce Surfel-Indexed View Memory (VMem), a memory module that remembers past views by indexing them geometrically based on the 3D surface elements (surfels) they have observed. VMem enables efficient retrieval of the most relevant past views when generating new ones. By focusing only on these relevant views, our method produces consistent explorations of imagined environments at a fraction of the computational cost required to use all past views as

overview: Warp-as-History (WAH) is a camera-controlled image-to-video method: it warps the input image along the requested camera path and treats those warps as the generation history that a video model then refines. overviewZh: Warp-as-History（WAH）是相机可控的图生视频方法：沿请求的相机轨迹对输入图像做 warp，并把这些 warp 当作「历史帧」交给视频模型细化。已用 Helios-Distilled 与 LoRA checkpoint 在 GPU 上验证：复现了官方 BMX/涂鸦 warp 视频 demo。
architecture: WAH = geometric warping + a Helios-Distilled diffusers runtime + a task LoRA; bundled Pi3 code renders warps from camera poses. Checkpoints are passed in through model_path/lora_path/pi3x_ckpt_path or the corresponding WAH_* environment variables.
architectureZh: WAH = 几何 warp + Helios-Distilled diffusers 运行时 + 任务 LoRA；内置的 Pi3 代码负责从相机位姿渲染 warp。checkpoint 通过 model_path/lora_path/pi3x_ckpt_path 或对应的 WAH_* 环境变量传入。
usageNotes: Run it in its dedicated conda environment: the official stack pins Python 3.10 and torch 2.5.0+cu121, so the unified env will not work. Pi3X is only needed when rendering warps from camera poses.

overviewZh: AC3D 分析并改进视频扩散中的相机控制，是 CogVideoX 的 ControlNet 风格插件。WorldFoundry 已集成官方推理适配器；实际推理仍需本地 AC3D ControlNet 和对应 CogVideoX 底座权重。
architecture: Per the paper (arXiv 2411.18673), AC3D locates camera-motion information in low-frequency early-timestep components and conditions only a subset of layers, improving control precision and visual quality. architectureZh: 按论文（arXiv 2411.18673），AC3D 发现相机运动信息集中在低频、早期时间步分量，因此仅对部分层做条件注入，同时提升控制精度与画质。提供 2B 与 5B 两个 ControlNet checkpoint；适配器保留官方 2B ControlNet 形状设置。

paper.title: AC3D: Analyzing and Improving 3D Camera Control in Video Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Numerous works have recently integrated 3D camera control into foundational text-to-video models, but the resulting camera control is often imprecise, and video generation quality suffers. In this work, we analyze camera motion from a first principles perspective, uncovering insights that enable precise 3D camera manipulation without compromising synthesis quality. First, we determine that motion induced by camera movements in videos is low-frequency in nature. This motivates us to adjust train and test pose conditioning schedules, accelerating training convergence while improving visual and motion quality. Then, by probing the representations of an unconditional video diffusion transformer, we observe that they implicitly perform camera pose estimation under the hood, and only a sub-portion of their layers contain the camera information. overview: ACT (Action Chunking Transformer) is the classic imitation-learning policy behind the ALOHA line of work: instead of predicting one action at a time it predicts chunks of future actions, smoothing control and reducing compounding error. WorldFoundry executes the full policy — DETR-VAE, transformer, ResNet backbone, preprocessing, and action-chunk aggregation.
overviewZh: ACT（Action Chunking Transformer）是 ALOHA 系列工作背后的经典模仿学习策略：不逐步预测单个动作，而是预测未来动作块，使控制更平滑并降低误差累积。WorldFoundry 完整执行该策略，包括 DETR-VAE、transformer、ResNet 骨干、预处理与动作块聚合。
architecture: A DETR-style transformer with a CVAE objective: a ResNet visual backbone feeds a transformer encoder-decoder that emits an action chunk; the VAE latent captures demonstration multimodality.
architectureZh: DETR 风格的 transformer 加 CVAE 目标：ResNet 视觉骨干馈入 transformer 编解码器并输出动作块；VAE 隐变量捕捉示范的多模态性。
usageNotes: Checkpoint-backed prediction requires a caller-staged policy_best.ckpt and matching dataset_stats.pkl. Checkpoint tensors use weights-only deserialization and statistics use a restricted NumPy-only reader, so no upstream pickle execution occurs.
usageNotesZh: checkpoint 驱动的预测需调用方就位 policy_best.ckpt 与匹配的 dataset_stats.pkl。checkpoint 张量采用 weights-only 反序列化，统计文件使用受限的仅 NumPy 读取器，不执行上游 pickle。
limitations: No official checkpoint is distributed; you must stage your own trained policy.
Designed for fixed-embodiment imitation; no language conditioning.
limitationsZh: 不提供官方 checkpoint；需自行就位训练好的策略。
面向固定本体的模仿学习；无语言条件。

paper.title: AlayaWorld: Long-Horizon and Playable Video World Generation
paper.abstract: Game worlds have traditionally been built through labor-intensive production pipelines, making them costly to develop, difficult to customization, and expensive to modify after deployment. Recent advances in video world models offer a fundamentally different paradigm. Rather than explicitly authoring every component of a virtual environment, these models autoregressively synthesize future observations conditioned on the current world state and user interactions, enabling playable worlds to be generated online. Trained on both gameplay recordings and real-world videos, they can capture diverse visual appearances and physical dynamics, opening new opportunities for interactive applications beyond gaming, including embodied intelligence. In this paper, we present \textbf{AlayaWorld}, a full-stack open-source framework for building interactive generative worlds. AlayaWorld enables open-ended

overview: Bernini is ByteDance's unified any-to-any visual generation model: one checkpoint covers text-to-image, image editing, text-to-video, video-to-video, and reference-guided video. The full ByteDance/Bernini-Diffusers checkpoint pairs a 7B semantic planner with a 14B renderer. WorldFoundry ships the official inference source and loads the self-contained Diffusers checkpoint directly, so no external Bernini checkout is needed.
overviewZh: Bernini 是字节跳动的统一「任意到任意」视觉生成模型：一个 checkpoint 同时覆盖文生图、图像编辑、文生视频、视频到视频与参考引导视频。完整的 ByteDance/Bernini-Diffusers checkpoint 内含 7B 语义规划器与 14B 渲染器。WorldFoundry 自带官方推理源码，直接加载自包含的 Diffusers checkpoint，无需外部 Bernini 检出。
architecture: Two-stage design: a 7B semantic planner produces an intermediate plan and a 14B renderer synthesizes the final pixels. Official recipes run single-request inference with 8-way Ulysses sequence parallelism (nproc_per_node=8, ulysses_size=8). The task_type input selects among the six task families at request time.
architectureZh: 两段式设计：7B 语义规划器先产出中间规划，14B 渲染器再合成最终像素。官方配方使用单请求 8 路 Ulysses 序列并行推理（nproc_per_node=8、ulysses_size=8）。请求时通过 task_type 输入在六类任务间切换。
usageNotes: The official dispatch needs one 8-GPU node with H100-class GPUs. If you do not have an 8-GPU node, use the renderer-only Bernini-R models instead — the 1.3B one runs on a single GPU.
usageNotesZh: 官方调度需要一台 8 卡 H100 级 GPU 节点。如果没有 8 卡节点，请改用仅渲染器的 Bernini-R 模型——其中 1.3B 版单卡可跑。

paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models have each reached remarkable maturity: MLLMs excel at reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal inputs with strong semantic grounding, while diffusion models synthesize images and videos with photorealistic fidelity. recipes.name: Cosmos3
recipes.summary: Cosmos3 is the newest, broadest Cosmos generation: one joint-modality model covering text-to-image/video, image/video-to-video, synchronized sound, and structured action inference (policy, forward and inverse dynamics), in Nano and Super v…

notes: Base Cosmos3 selection routes to Nano; select the cosmos3-super variant for the Super checkpoint.
This generator binding exposes T2I, T2V, I2V, and V2V inference, optional synchronized sound, and structured policy, forward-dynamics, and inverse-dynamics action inference.
Cosmos3 Reasoner, training, and vLLM/vLLM-Omni serving workflows are intentionally outside this infer-only integration.
Native transformer loading is structurally exact (814/814 keys for Nano), the shared Wan VAE38 mapping is exact (196/196), and the AVAE decoder is exact (182/182).
The native 35-step Karras flow-UniPC schedule and numerical updates match the official scheduler exactly. End-to-end GPU output parity for this new native path remains pending.
Use prepare_model_infer.sh to emit a revision report and an explicit pinned snapshot model-ref; an existing unverified or older Cosmos3-Nano directory is not evidence for this profile revision.
Safety screening is an orchestration extension rather than part of the native diffusion model runtime; the generator itself has no guardrail framework dependency.
Uses WorldFoundry's native diffusion loader, joint-modality runner, core attention, Wan VAE38, and flow-UniPC implementation. Diffusers is not installed or imported.
Synchronized sound uses the inference-only native AVAE decoder loaded directly from the official sound-tokenizer safetensors component.
Cosmos3 Reasoner, training, and vLLM/vLLM-Omni serving dependencies are intentionally omitted.

Includes the minimal FastAPI/Pydantic/YAML surface imported by workspace_job so the dedicated model environment can execute the real Workspace inference entrypoint, not only the base runtime. Msgpack and WebSockets complete the declared WorldFoundry job/transport dependency surface.
Pins ffmpeg to conda-forge to keep its OpenH264 ABI consistent; core audio muxing also falls back to the imageio-ffmpeg bundled executable if a host ffmpeg binary cannot start.

architecture: The causal student reuses the Cosmos action DiT, Reason1 encoder, and Wan codec. Clean prefill writes request-local three-frame KV history; noisy sampling only reads it. Window continuation retains nine RGB frames and eight aligned historical actions.
architectureZh: 因果学生复用 Cosmos 动作 DiT、Reason1 编码器与 Wan 编解码。干净上下文预填充写入请求专属三潜帧 KV 历史，噪声采样只读取历史。窗口续接保存九帧 RGB 与八步对齐的历史动作。
usageNotes: Supply student_checkpoint_path, one initial image, normalized 384-D actions, and shared Cosmos tokenizer/Reason1 assets. First STEP consumes 12 actions and returns 13 frames; subsequent STEP consumes 4 actions and returns 4 new frames at a 10-fps playback clock. Reset retains weights.
usageNotesZh: 提供 student_checkpoint_path、一幅初始图像、归一化 384 维动作与共享 Cosmos tokenizer/Reason1 资产。首次 STEP 消费 12 步动作并返回 13 帧，后续每次消费 4 步新动作并按 10 fps 播放时钟返回 4 帧新像素。重置保留权重。
highlightsZh: 公开的 Hugging Face 权重
limitations: The pinned DreamDojo Hub snapshot contains no distilled student checkpoint; explicit student assets are required.
Student checkpoint-backed quality, official parity, closed-loop robot success, and 10-fps inference throughput are not yet validated.
Dataset normalization and teleoperation mapping remain caller-owned; WASD controls are not robot actions.
limitationsZh: 固定的 DreamDojo Hub 快照不包含蒸馏学生 checkpoint，需要显式学生资产。
尚未验证学生真实权重输出质量、官方一致性、机器人闭环成功率或 10 fps 推理吞吐。
数据集归一化与遥操作映射由调用方负责；WASD 控制不等于机器人动作。

overview: DynamiCrafter animates open-domain still images by leveraging video diffusion priors — you give it a picture (optionally a prompt) and it produces a plausible motion clip. Two variants run at different resolutions: dynamicrafter-512-i2v and dynamicrafter-1024-i2v, both in-tree WorldFoundry runtimes.
overviewZh: DynamiCrafter 借助视频扩散先验为开放域静态图片赋予动态——给它一张图（可附提示词），即可生成合理的运动视频。提供两个不同分辨率的 variant：dynamicrafter-512-i2v 与 dynamicrafter-1024-i2v，均为树内 WorldFoundry 运行时。
architecture: DynamiCrafter is a U-Net-era latent video diffusion model with a dual-stream image conditioning design (CLIP image features plus VAE-encoded image latents), per its publication. WorldFoundry exposes two resolution profiles with the standard prompt/image/video/actions input schema.
architectureZh: DynamiCrafter 属 U-Net 时代的潜空间视频扩散模型，采用双流图像条件设计（CLIP 图像特征加 VAE 编码的图像潜变量），见其论文。WorldFoundry 提供两个分辨率 profile，使用标准的 prompt/image/video/actions 输入 schema。
usageNotes: Start with the 512 variant for speed; switch to 1024 for final quality.
usageNotesZh: 建议先用 512 版求快，再用 1024 版出成品。

overviewZh: EasyAnimate 是阿里 PAI 团队基于 DiT 的视频生成项目，覆盖文生视频、图生视频与视频到视频。WorldFoundry 运行其 V5.1 图生视频路径，WRBench 相机控制评测使用同一运行时。别名 easyanimate_i2v、easyanimate-i2v 指向该模型。
architecture: The route uses the official V5.1 Flow scheduler with the InP (inpainting-style image-conditioned) checkpoint family and maps height/width to sample_size. `*-InP` checkpoints are the image-to-video models; the non-InP EasyAnimateV5.1-7b-zh checkpoint is the text-to-video model.

paper.title: Echo-Memory: A Controlled Study of Memory in Action World Models
paper.abstract: We present \textbf{Echo-Memory}, a controlled study of memory mechanisms in action-conditioned world models. These models generate multi-segment videos from a first frame, text prompt, and camera-action sequence, but their central failure is often memory rather than local image synthesis: after the camera leaves and returns, the scene or salient object may silently change. Existing memory designs are hard to compare because gains are entangled with backbone, training, retrieval, and evaluation differences. Echo-Memory fixes the action-to-video interface and varies only how history is stored and read by the generator. Under a shared video diffusion backbone, optimizer, camera-action representation, sampler, and evaluation pipeline, we compare raw context, compression-based memory, spatial summaries with different read-out paths, and state-space recurrence. overview: FastFrames generates 480p video autoregressively at interactive latency by combining a two-step causal Wan2.1 DiT with a lightweight KV refinement network (eliminating the clean-context DiT pass) and a causal ConvNeXt pixel decoder (replacing the Wan2.1 VAE decoder). WorldFoundry integrates both FastFrames-S (1.3B) and FastFrames-L (14B).
overviewZh: FastFrames 将两步因果 Wan2.1 DiT、轻量级 KV 细化网络（替代每帧的干净上下文 DiT 前向）与因果 ConvNeXt 像素解码器（替代 Wan2.1 VAE 解码器）结合，实现交互级延迟的 480p 自回归视频生成。WorldFoundry 集成了 FastFrames-S（1.3B）与 FastFrames-L（14B）。
architecture: Per arXiv:2611.23226, frame 0 is denoised in four steps followed by a clean t=0 pass; subsequent latent frames run two denoising steps on a shift-5 rectified-flow schedule, repair their KV cache entries via a shared spatial stem plus batched per-layer GroupGEMM heads, and decode pre-head DiT hidden states directly into 4 RGB frames per latent frame (with a bias-free 5120->1536 bridge for FastFrames-L).
architectureZh: 按论文 arXiv:2611.23226，第 0 潜帧使用 4 步去噪并执行一次 t=0 干净前向；后续每个潜帧在 shift=5 的 rectified-flow 时间表上执行 2 步去噪，通过共享空间 stem 与分层批量 GroupGEMM 头部修复 KV 缓存，并直接将 pre-head DiT 隐状态解码为每潜帧 4 帧 RGB 像素（FastFrames-L 通过无偏置 5120->1536 bridge 衔接像素解码器）。
usageNotes: Defaults match the official CLI (832x480, 81 frames from 21 latent frames, 16 fps, context="refiner"). FastFrames-S uses the frozen Causal Forcing++ 2-step generator with apple/FastFrames-S add-on weights and Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B UMT5-XXL; FastFrames-L uses apple/FastFrames-L weights and Wan2.1-T2V-14B UMT5-XXL.
usageNotesZh: 默认参数与官方 CLI 一致（832x480、由 21 个潜帧对齐得到的 81 帧、16 fps、context="refiner"）。FastFrames-S 组合冻结的 Causal Forcing++ 两步生成器、apple/FastFrames-S 附加权重与 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 的 UMT5-XXL；FastFrames-L 使用 apple/FastFrames-L 权重与 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 的 UMT5-XXL。

overview: FramePack is a low-memory approach to long image-to-video generation: it packs input frame context into fixed-length representations so generation cost stays roughly constant as the video grows. WorldFoundry runs a minimal infer-only FramePack runtime through the shared pipeline contract.
overviewZh: FramePack 是面向长视频图生视频的低显存方案：它把输入帧上下文压缩进定长表示，使生成成本不随视频变长而显著增长。WorldFoundry 通过共享 pipeline 契约运行最小化的仅推理 FramePack 运行时。
architecture: FramePack (from the authors of ControlNet at Stanford) wraps a video diffusion backbone with a frame-context packing scheme that keeps a constant-length conditioning window, enabling minute-scale clips on modest VRAM. It takes a text prompt and a start image.
architectureZh: FramePack（作者来自斯坦福，ControlNet 团队）在视频扩散基座外包了一层帧上下文打包机制，维持定长条件窗口，使得在有限显存上也能生成分钟级视频。输入为文本提示词与起始图像。
usageNotes: The I2V route generates video from a prompt and a start image. Best used when you need long clips on a single consumer-class GPU.
usageNotesZh: I2V 路径根据提示词与起始图像生成视频。最适合在单张消费级 GPU 上生成较长视频的场景。

recipes.summary: Helios is PKU-YuanGroup's long-video generation family covering T2V, I2V, V2V, and long-video generation, released in three checkpoints: Helios-Distilled (default, efficient), Helios-Mid, and Helios-Base (best quality). All three checkpoin…

notes: Helios generates in 33-frame chunks; the in-tree pipeline rounds requested frame counts up to a compatible chunk count.
Helios-Distilled is the default efficient checkpoint.
Resident Distilled sessions keep the native latent histories and accept user prompt updates at chunk boundaries; Helios does not expose keyboard camera controls.

Helios Base completed a real A100 Workspace checkpoint-load and decode smoke at 384x640 and 33 frames; the run used three total denoising steps with a [1, 1, 1] pyramid, so it verifies executable Base wiring and a finite nonblank video artifact but does not claim parity with the official [20, 20, 20] quality recipe. The smoke artifact SHA256 is cdb64cb8764ab05765ff01338f3ac02159218b7dfc606f64b72647c438fc95f7.
Non-A100 targets rely on the shared PyTorch attention and offload paths and still require hardware-specific validation.

Helios Mid also completed a real A100 Workspace checkpoint-load and full-decode smoke at 384x640 and 33 frames. Its three-step [1, 1, 1] output is finite and time-varying but visually abstract, so it validates executable wiring only and is not a prompt-quality demo or official [20, 20, 20] parity claim. The artifact SHA256 is f077a93334d69ee1939a62443c6a1e5c3848070d309d539434e56da49b5ee92e.

Helios follows its official PyTorch 2.10 and source Diffusers environment rather than the shared environment. The former Helios feature repository was removed; this profile pins the public head of the official Diffusers Helios PR (#13208) until it lands on main.
Install the PyTorch wheels from the CUDA 12.8 index on CUDA 12.8 hosts.
Optional training-only dependencies from the upstream requirements file are intentionally omitted.

overview: Helios is PKU-YuanGroup's long-video generation family covering T2V, I2V, V2V, and long-video generation, released in three checkpoints: Helios-Distilled (default, efficient), Helios-Mid, and Helios-Base (best quality). All three checkpoints are available as variants. Resident Distilled sessions keep the native 9-latent/33-frame history and accept prompt changes between segments. overview: JoyAI-Echo 1.5 is an inference-only long-form audio-video generator. Its R2V request can combine a prompt, an optional first frame, and as many as seven ordered image/audio memory slots so identity, voice, and story context persist across independently editable shots.
overviewZh: JoyAI-Echo 1.5 是仅推理的长时程音视频生成模型。R2V 请求可组合提示词、可选首帧与最多七个有序图像/音频记忆槽，使角色身份、声音与故事上下文在可独立编辑的镜头间延续。
architecture: The release builds on LTX-2.3 and adds few-step DMD generation plus a paired cross-modal memory bank. WorldFoundry packages the inference code from jd-opensource/JoyAI-Echo at 0b931fd4, reuses canonical LTX components, and runs its package-module CLI in the dedicated Python 3.11, PyTorch 2.8, CUDA 12.8 environment.
architectureZh: 该版本基于 LTX-2.3，加入少步 DMD 生成与成对跨模态记忆库。WorldFoundry 将 jd-opensource/JoyAI-Echo 的 0b931fd4 版本推理代码纳入包内，复用规范 LTX 组件，在专用 Python 3.11、PyTorch 2.8、CUDA 12.8 环境中以包模块方式运行 CLI。
usageNotes: Prepare the dedicated environment and pass the local Echo and gated Gemma checkpoints. Generation runs only when execute=True is set. FP4 also needs NVIDIA ModelOpt.
usageNotesZh: 请准备专用环境，并传入本地 Echo checkpoint 与受限访问的 Gemma checkpoint。生成必须显式设置 execute=True。FP4 还需 NVIDIA ModelOpt。

paper.title: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
paper.abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction aims to recover 3D information, such as camera poses and point clouds, from a video stream, which necessitates geometric accuracy, temporal consistency, and computational efficiency. Motivated by the principles of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), we introduce LingBot-Map, a feed-forward 3D foundation model for reconstructing scenes from streaming data, built upon a geometric context transformer (GCT) architecture. A defining aspect of LingBot-Map lies in its carefully designed attention mechanism, which integrates an anchor context, a pose-reference window, and a trajectory memory to address coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction, respectively. This design keeps the streaming state compact while retaining rich geometric context, enabling stable efficient inference at around 20 FPS on 518 x 378 resolution inputs

recipes.name: LingBot-Video
recipes.summary: LingBot-Video is Robbyant's video generation family for text-to-image, text-to-video, text+image-to-video, and video refinement. It comes in two checkpoint lines: a dense 1.3B model and a MoE 30B-A3B model that ships with a refiner.

notes: The runtime owns only inference code. Rewriter and training surfaces are outside this integration.
T2I produces an image despite the default runtime profile artifact being the T2V video route.
The upstream recommended stack requires a dedicated Transformers 5 / Diffusers 0.39 environment.
The released Dense 1.3B checkpoint has a 121-frame, 832x480 quality-oriented Workspace artifact.

The released MoE 30B-A3B main transformer, 8.88GB text encoder, and FP32 VAE completed a real single-A100 Workspace run with the optional refiner disabled. The one-step smoke produced five fully decodable 192x320 frames (artifact SHA256 4458abda4089e0019587ab388f6ce10f47964af3033f32e060729ddb961ad7f7), proving the large-checkpoint execution path only; its visibly blurred output is not a quality demo.

A second MoE Workspace run used 20 denoising steps for nine 256x416 frames. Its first, middle, and last frames show a coherent industrial workbench, black robot mechanism, and red block without the one-step blur; artifact SHA256 is b3211b8ece8a73519bb7c3589cbeebf8c59b4cc473c86cc0e630f833dad2c6f3. This is a quality-oriented short smoke, not parity with the official 480x832, 121-frame, 40-step recipe.

The MoE single-device path is physically validated on A100 80GB and H100 80GB. On H100, a public 480x832, 25-frame, 20-step T2V run produced a fully decodable video without the refiner; its small-toy-car output remains a prompt-specific quality concern, and peak observed memory was 80,991 MiB (about 79.1 GiB) on an H100 reporting 81,559 MiB total.

The pinned official script and in-tree runner each produced a coherent 25-frame, 832x480 T2V video from official example 1 with only duration shortened from five to one second, 40 steps and matching seed. Frame-aligned decoded RGB MAE averaged 10.48/255; this validates the short-clip configuration qualitatively, not pixel-exact parity. The five-second recipe, refiner, and other modes remain unvalidated. Other Hopper…

The in-tree Diffusers backend is validated with the existing CUDA 12.8 unified environment (PyTorch 2.11, Diffusers 0.38, Transformers 5.3); the previous dedicated environment resolved to an unprovisioned Python 3.12 prefix and could not import NumPy or Torch.
SGLang and Triton are optional deployment dependencies and are not installed by this base profile.

The released Dense 1.3B checkpoint has a 121-frame, 832x480 quality-oriented Workspace artifact.

The released MoE 30B-A3B main transformer, 8.88GB text encoder, and FP32 VAE completed a real single-A100 Workspace run with the optional refiner disabled. The one-step smoke produced five fully decodable 192x320 frames (artifact SHA256 4458abda4089e0019587ab388f6ce10f47964af3033f32e060729ddb961ad7f7), proving the large-checkpoint execution path only; its visibly blurred output is not a quality demo.

A second MoE Workspace run used 20 denoising steps for nine 256x416 frames. Its first, middle, and last frames show a coherent industrial workbench, black robot mechanism, and red block without the one-step blur; artifact SHA256 is b3211b8ece8a73519bb7c3589cbeebf8c59b4cc473c86cc0e630f833dad2c6f3. This is a quality-oriented short smoke, not parity with the official 480x832, 121-frame, 40-step recipe.

The MoE single-device path is physically validated on A100 80GB and H100 80GB. On H100, a public 480x832, 25-frame, 20-step T2V run produced a fully decodable video without the refiner; its small-toy-car output remains a prompt-specific quality concern, and peak observed memory was 80,991 MiB (about 79.1 GiB) on an H100 reporting 81,559 MiB total.

The pinned official script and in-tree runner each produced a coherent 25-frame, 832x480 T2V video from official example 1 with only duration shortened from five to one second, 40 steps and matching seed. Frame-aligned decoded RGB MAE averaged 10.48/255; this validates the short-clip configuration qualitatively, not pixel-exact parity. The five-second recipe, refiner, and other modes remain unvalidated. Other Hopper…

NativeDiffusionPipeline runs the ltx-2.5 joint-multistage recipe in-process with canonical Gemma 4, transformer, diffusion video decoder and duration-head components, shared loading/offload and BT.709 H.264/AAC media encoding. architecture: Uses the same native transformer, VAE, scheduler, loader, and joint-state runner as LTX-2.x. The T5 text encoder loads as a Transformers model; Diffusers is not an inference backend. The spatial upscaler runs automatically between the two denoising stages.
architectureZh: 与 LTX-2.x 共用同一套原生 Transformer、VAE、调度器、加载器与联合状态 runner。T5 文本编码器以 Transformers 模型加载；Diffusers 不是推理后端。空间上采样器在两段去噪之间自动运行。
usageNotes: The distilled recipe is fixed at 10 Euler steps (7 + 3) with guidance 1.0; the runtime rejects other step counts or CFG values. The official Hugging Face cards report license 'other'; review them before commercial use.
usageNotesZh: 蒸馏配方固定为 10 步 Euler（先 7 后 3）、guidance 1.0，运行时会拒绝其他步数或 CFG。官方 Hugging Face 卡片许可为“other”，商用前请审阅。

overviewZh: Luma Ray2 是 Luma AI 的托管视频生成模型，支持文生视频与图生视频。WorldFoundry 的 Studio pipeline 封装了 Luma API：一条提示词或一帧起始图，最终以标准 WorldFoundry 结果目录中的可下载视频呈现。模型在 Luma 的服务器上运行，不在本地运行。
architecture: Luma Ray2 is a hosted, provider-operated model; Luma has not published its architecture, parameter count, or training recipe. The Studio pipeline submits requests to the Luma API endpoint and collects the returned video.
architectureZh: Luma Ray2 是由服务方托管运行的模型；Luma 未公开其架构、参数规模或训练细节。Studio pipeline 向 Luma API 端点提交请求并回收生成的视频。
usageNotes: Supply your own Luma account and API key through LUMA_API_KEY (or LUMALABS_API_KEY); keys are issued through Luma's developer platform (lumalabs.ai). No weights are downloaded and no local GPU is needed — generation happens on the provider side, so cost, quota, and content policy follow your provider account.
usageNotesZh: 需自备 Luma 账号与 API key，通过 LUMA_API_KEY（或 LUMALABS_API_KEY）提供；API key 通过 Luma 开发者平台（lumalabs.ai）签发。本地不会下载任何权重，也不需要 GPU——生成在服务方完成，费用、配额与内容政策均以你的服务方账号为准。

Transformers 5.5 supplies Qwen3_5TextModel; the parent pipeline can keep Transformers 4.x in the unified environment.

paper.title: Multiplayer Interactive World Models with Representation Autoencoders
paper.abstract: We introduce the first multiplayer world model for highly dynamic environments governed by complex physical interactions. Whereas single-player world models treat the other agents as part of the environment, ours conditions on the action streams of multiple agents, learning to attribute changes in the scene to the correct player and to stay coherent under arbitrary combinations of their actions. We study this problem in the game of Rocket League, where players compete and cooperate under fast, tightly coupled dynamics. Trained on 10,000 hours of gameplay collected with publicly available bots, our 5-billion-parameter latent diffusion model generates four-player matches in real time, producing 20 frames per second on a single Nvidia B200 GPU. paper.title: MVDiffusion: Enabling Holistic Multi-view Image Generation with Correspondence-Aware Diffusion
paper.abstract: This paper introduces MVDiffusion, a simple yet effective method for generating consistent multi-view images from text prompts given pixel-to-pixel correspondences (e.g., perspective crops from a panorama or multi-view images given depth maps and poses). Unlike prior methods that rely on iterative image warping and inpainting, MVDiffusion simultaneously generates all images with a global awareness, effectively addressing the prevalent error accumulation issue. At its core, MVDiffusion processes perspective images in parallel with a pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model, while integrating novel correspondence-aware attention layers to facilitate cross-view interactions. For panorama generation, while only trained with 10k panoramas, MVDiffusion is able to generate high-resolution photorealistic images for arbitrary texts or extrapolate one perspective image to a 360-degree view. overview: OmniVinci is NVIDIA's omni-modal understanding LLM: one model that reasons over images, video, and audio together. It answers questions rather than generating media: tasks are multimodal reasoning, audio reasoning, and image/video question answering, and the artifact is a model_response.
overviewZh: OmniVinci 是英伟达的全模态理解大模型：单一模型同时对图像、视频与音频进行推理。它用于回答问题而非生成内容：任务为多模态推理、音频推理与图像/视频问答，产物是 model_response。
architecture: OmniVinci combines a Qwen2 causal decoder, a Dynamic-S2 SigLIP vision tower and a Qwen2Audio encoder with temporal pooling and rotary embeddings. WorldFoundry packages the Apache-2.0 inference glue from nvidia/omnivinci revision 7b3777b and loads its backbones from local checkpoint data.
architectureZh: OmniVinci 结合 Qwen2 自回归解码器、Dynamic-S2 SigLIP 视觉编码器与 Qwen2Audio 音频编码器，并使用时间池化和旋转位置编码。WorldFoundry 将 nvidia/omnivinci 的 7b3777b 版本 Apache-2.0 推理组件纳入包内，从本地 checkpoint 数据加载模型骨干。
usageNotes: Use it to ask questions about images and videos, rather than to generate content. Video requests default to 8 frames (max_video_frames accepts 1–128); load_audio_in_video is false by default. The local checkpoint must include its llm, vision_tower, sound_tower and both projector directories, tokenizer data and qwen2.jinja.
usageNotesZh: 用于图像与视频问答，而非内容生成。视频请求默认采样 8 帧（max_video_frames 接受 1–128）；load_audio_in_video 默认为 false。本地 checkpoint 需包含 llm、vision_tower、sound_tower、两个投影器目录、tokenizer 数据和 qwen2.jinja。

overview: Open-MAGVIT2 is Tencent ARC's open reproduction of the MAGVIT-v2 lookup-free visual tokenizer, plus autoregressive generation on top of it. overviewZh: Open-MAGVIT2 是腾讯 ARC 对 MAGVIT-v2 免查表（lookup-free）视觉分词器的开源复现，并在其上构建自回归生成。WorldFoundry 运行其 ImageNet 类条件图像生成路径：256 token 生成产出 256x256 的 PNG 图像，而非视频。已用发布的 checkpoint 验证：生成 ImageNet 类别 207 得到语义正确的图像。
architecture: Two parts: the lookup-free quantization (LFQ) tokenizer with a very large codebook, and an autoregressive transformer that predicts visual tokens for a requested ImageNet class. The class_id input selects the category.
architectureZh: 包含两部分：带超大码本的免查表量化（LFQ）分词器，以及为指定 ImageNet 类别预测视觉 token 的自回归 Transformer。class_id 输入选择类别。
usageNotes: Stage the TencentARC/Open-MAGVIT2 weights (apache-2.0) and set class_id to choose the ImageNet category. This route is class-conditional image generation, not prompt-to-video; video tokenization is an upstream tokenizer capability.
usageNotesZh: 请就位 TencentARC/Open-MAGVIT2 权重（apache-2.0），并用 class_id 选择 ImageNet 类别。该路径是类条件图像生成，不是提示词生成视频；视频分词是其分词器在上游支持的能力。
highlightsZh: 公开的 Hugging Face 权重
limitations: The runnable route generates class-conditional images only — no free-form prompts, no video output.
ImageNet-class conditioning limits subject diversity to the 1000 classes.
limitationsZh: 可运行路径仅支持类条件图像生成——没有自由提示词，也没有视频输出。

architectureZh: 按论文，极线 Transformer 消解两视图间的尺度歧义，网络预测高斯参数的概率分布。WorldFoundry 封装官方测试入口；代码与 checkpoint 镜像 dylanebert/pixelSplat 均为 MIT 许可。

usageNotesZh: model_path 指向 re10k.ckpt 或 acid.ckpt，同时指定匹配的 experiment 与标定数据 dataset_roots/index_path。需安装已声明的运行依赖和本地高斯光栅化扩展。仅传图像列表时使用合成基线。PLY 导出归一化几何、DC 颜色和标准透明度 logit。

limitationsZh: 支持原始卷积版本权重，不能直接替换为更新的 camera-ready 网络权重。

paper.title: Rolling Forcing: Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion in Real Time
paper.abstract: Streaming video generation, as one fundamental component in interactive world models and neural game engines, aims to generate high-quality, low-latency, and temporally coherent long video streams. However, most existing work suffers from severe error accumulation that often significantly degrades the generated stream videos over long horizons. We design Rolling Forcing, a novel video generation technique that enables streaming long videos with minimal error accumulation. Rolling Forcing comes with three novel designs. First, instead of iteratively sampling individual frames, which accelerates error propagation, we design a joint denoising scheme that simultaneously denoises multiple frames with progressively increasing noise levels. This design relaxes the strict causality across adjacent frames, effectively suppressing error growth. Second, we introduce the attention sink mechanism int

paper.title: SANA-WM: Efficient Minute-Scale World Modeling with Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer
paper.abstract: We introduce SANA-WM, an efficient 2.6B-parameter open-source world model natively trained for one-minute generation, synthesizing high-fidelity, 720p, minute-scale videos with precise camera control. SANA-WM achieves visual quality comparable to large-scale industrial baselines such as LingBot-World and HY-WorldPlay, while significantly improving efficiency. Four core designs drive our architecture: (1) Hybrid Linear Attention combines frame-wise Gated DeltaNet (GDN) with softmax attention for memory-efficient long-context modeling. (2) Dual-Branch Camera Control ensures precise 6-DoF trajectory adherence. (3) Two-Stage Generation Pipeline applies a long-video refiner to stage-1 outputs, improving quality and consistency across sequences. (4) Robust Annotation Pipeline extracts accurate metric-scale 6-DoF camera poses from public videos to yield high-quality, spatiotemporally consistent

recipes.name: Stable Video Infinity 2.0
recipes.summary: Stable Video Infinity 2.0 (SVI) generates arbitrarily long videos by chaining clips with five-frame continuation and per-clip seed changes, driven by prompt streams. Validated with the default settings on an A100: two linked 81-frame clips…

notes: The runtime uses SVI 2.0's official five-motion-frame continuation and full reference padding defaults.
The official 999-clip cap is bounded to two clips per prompt unless use_first_prompt_only is explicitly enabled.
Each clip receives a distinct seed by default; prompt streams repeat each prompt twice before advancing.
The source tree contains inference code only. Wan and SVI weights are resolved from local checkpoint staging.

A full Workspace default run on an A100 loaded all seven Wan2.1-I2V-14B DiT shards, T5, CLIP, the FP32 VAE path, and all 400 released SVI 2.0 LoRA pairs. It generated two linked 81-frame, 50-step clips and removed the five-frame overlap to produce 157 frames at 832x544 and 24 FPS.

The 157-frame H.264 artifact fully decoded to a finite uint8 array. Its SHA256 is 987a9fe3d938ed835ac6d64e45acb5921520741d51e8075b24aa1fe0d9320ee9; the segment seam temporal MAE is 7.58, 0.9% above the official native clip's observed 7.51 maximum frame delta.

An exact-setting 81-frame comparison against the pinned official runtime reached 31.03 dB PSNR, 4.05 pixel MAE, and 0.993 luma correlation. The fixed single-clip artifact SHA256 is 7a5b542ec863180ef96a4ac478c6e557fa72613025d5223f09108c62e1e41b1e.
Hopper, Blackwell, and lower-memory offload configurations are explicit runtime targets, not hardware-validated claims.
The official project reports A100 80GB, CUDA 12, and Torch 2.4-2.8 testing; WorldFoundry uses its shared cu128 runtime.
FlashAttention 2.8 can be installed as an optimization, but the in-tree attention dispatcher has supported fallbacks.
xfuser is installed for the optional use_usp execution path; single-process inference leaves it unused.
FastAPI, Pydantic, and YAML are declared because Workspace dispatch imports the real workspace_job entrypoint inside the model environment.

overviewZh: Stable Video Infinity 2.0（SVI）通过五帧续接与逐段换种子来串联视频段，由提示词流驱动，可生成任意长度的视频。已在 A100 上以默认设置验证：两段相接的 81 帧 832x544 视频组成 157 帧 H.264 视频，与官方运行时在相同设置下对比达到 31.03 dB PSNR。

The official 999-clip cap is bounded to two clips per prompt unless use_first_prompt_only is enabled. Stage both the SVI LoRA (vita-video-gen/svi-model, MIT) and the Wan2.1 base.

paper.title: Stable Video Infinity: Infinite-Length Video Generation with Error Recycling
paper.abstract: We propose Stable Video Infinity (SVI) that is able to generate infinite-length videos with high temporal consistency, plausible scene transitions, and controllable streaming storylines. While existing long-video methods attempt to mitigate accumulated errors via handcrafted anti-drifting (e.g., modified noise scheduler, frame anchoring), they remain limited to single-prompt extrapolation, producing homogeneous scenes with repetitive motions. We identify that the fundamental challenge extends beyond error accumulation to a critical discrepancy between the training assumption (seeing clean data) and the test-time autoregressive reality (conditioning on self-generated, error-prone outputs). To bridge this hypothesis gap, SVI incorporates Error-Recycling Fine-Tuning, a new type of efficient training that recycles the Diffusion Transformer (DiT)'s self-generated errors into supervisory promp

paper.title: T2V-Turbo: Breaking the Quality Bottleneck of Video Consistency Model with Mixed Reward Feedback
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based text-to-video (T2V) models have achieved significant success but continue to be hampered by the slow sampling speed of their iterative sampling processes. To address the challenge, consistency models have been proposed to facilitate fast inference, albeit at the cost of sample quality. In this work, we aim to break the quality bottleneck of a video consistency model (VCM) to achieve $\textbf{both fast and high-quality video generation}$. We introduce T2V-Turbo, which integrates feedback from a mixture of differentiable reward models into the consistency distillation (CD) process of a pre-trained T2V model. Notably, we directly optimize rewards associated with single-step generations that arise naturally from computing the CD loss, effectively bypassing the memory constraints imposed by backpropagating gradients through an iterative sampling process. WorldFoundry submits generation requests through Google's API and collects the rendered clips as artifacts, so Veo 3 results can be lined up against open models in the same evaluation harness. overviewZh: Veo3 是 Google DeepMind 的 Veo 3 托管视频模型，支持文生视频与图生视频。WorldFoundry 通过 Google 的 API 提交生成请求并把渲染结果收为产物，使 Veo 3 的结果可以与开源模型在同一套评测框架下对比。模型本体始终运行在 Google 的基础设施上。
architecture: This is a hosted, provider-operated model: the vendor has not published its architecture, parameter count, or training recipe. WorldFoundry provides a Studio pipeline that submits requests to the provider endpoint and collects the returned video artifacts.
architectureZh: 这是由服务方托管运行的模型：厂商未公开其架构、参数规模或训练细节。WorldFoundry 提供一条 Studio pipeline，向服务方端点提交请求并回收生成的视频产物。
usageNotes: Supply your own provider API key and account. No weights are downloaded and no GPU environment is provisioned locally — generation happens on the provider side, so cost, quota, and content policy follow your provider account. Veo access is provisioned through Google's AI developer offerings (e.g. the Gemini API); regional availability applies.
usageNotesZh: 你需要自备服务方的 API key 与账号。本地不会下载任何权重、也不会创建 GPU 环境——生成在服务方完成，费用、配额与内容政策均以你的服务方账号为准。Veo 的访问通过 Google 的 AI 开发者产品（如 Gemini API）开通，并受地区可用性限制。

overview: VideoCrafter is Tencent AI Lab's open video generation toolbox. The family groups the in-tree infer-only runtimes for VideoCrafter1 I2V, VideoCrafter1 T2V, and VideoCrafter2 T2V; each route also has its own model page (videocrafter1-i2v, videocrafter1-t2v, videocrafter2-t2v).
overviewZh: VideoCrafter 是腾讯 AI Lab 的开源视频生成工具箱。该系列包含 VideoCrafter1 I2V、VideoCrafter1 T2V 与 VideoCrafter2 T2V 的树内仅推理运行时；每条路径也有独立的模型页（videocrafter1-i2v、videocrafter1-t2v、videocrafter2-t2v）。
architecture: U-Net latent video diffusion models: VideoCrafter1 offers T2V (up to 1024x576) and I2V; VideoCrafter2 improves the T2V model by decoupling appearance learning (low-quality video + high-quality image data). Training, dataset, and download helpers are not included.
architectureZh: U-Net 潜空间视频扩散模型：VideoCrafter1 提供 T2V（最高 1024x576）与 I2V；VideoCrafter2 通过解耦外观学习（低质量视频 + 高质量图像数据）改进 T2V。不包含训练、数据集与下载辅助脚本。
usageNotes: VideoCrafter2 T2V is the default route. The VideoCrafter2 Hugging Face card declares Apache-2.0; the older Text2Video/Image2Video cards declare no license.
usageNotesZh: 默认路径是 VideoCrafter2 T2V。VideoCrafter2 的 HF 卡片声明 Apache-2.0；更早的 Text2Video/Image2Video 卡片未声明许可。
highlightsZh: 公开的 Hugging Face 权重

architecture: A U-Net latent video diffusion model conditioned on the input image embedding (per the upstream release). Training and download scripts are not included.
architectureZh: 以输入图像嵌入为条件的 U-Net 潜空间视频扩散模型（见上游发布）。不包含训练与下载脚本。
usageNotes: Expect 2023-era quality: short clips, modest motion. For higher fidelity image animation use DynamiCrafter or the DiT-based I2V models.
usageNotesZh: 预期是 2023 年代的质量：短片、运动幅度有限。若要更高保真的图像动画，请用 DynamiCrafter 或 DiT 系图生视频模型。

overview: Wan 2.5 API is the hosted DashScope endpoint for Alibaba's Wan 2.5 video generation model, for text-to-video and image-to-video. Unlike the open-weight Wan releases that WorldFoundry runs locally, it uses the provider-hosted generation path: requests go to Alibaba Cloud DashScope and finished clips come back as artifacts. Aliases wan2.5 and wan-2.5 also resolve to this model.
overviewZh: Wan 2.5 API 是阿里巴巴通义万相 Wan 2.5 视频生成模型的 DashScope 托管接入点，支持文生视频与图生视频。与 WorldFoundry 本地运行的开源 Wan 权重不同，它走服务方托管的生成路径：请求发往阿里云 DashScope，成片以产物形式返回。别名 wan2.5、wan-2.5 同样解析到该模型。
architecture: The hosted Wan 2.5 shares the Wan family lineage (diffusion-transformer video generation developed by Alibaba's Tongyi Lab), but Alibaba has not published the exact architecture or scale of the API-served revision.
architectureZh: 托管版 Wan 2.5 属于 Wan 系列（阿里通义实验室研发的扩散 Transformer 视频生成模型），但 API 所服务修订版的确切架构与规模并未公开。
usageNotes: Supply your own provider API key and account. No weights are downloaded and no GPU environment is provisioned locally — generation happens on the provider side, so cost, quota, and content policy follow your provider account. Keys are issued via Alibaba Cloud DashScope (dashscope.aliyun.com).
usageNotesZh: 你需要自备服务方的 API key 与账号。本地不会下载任何权重、也不会创建 GPU 环境——生成在服务方完成，费用、配额与内容政策均以你的服务方账号为准。API key 通过阿里云 DashScope（dashscope.aliyun.com）开通。

paper.title: WonderJourney: Going from Anywhere to Everywhere
paper.abstract: We introduce WonderJourney, a modularized framework for perpetual 3D scene generation. Unlike prior work on view generation that focuses on a single type of scenes, we start at any user-provided location (by a text description or an image) and generate a journey through a long sequence of diverse yet coherently connected 3D scenes. We leverage an LLM to generate textual descriptions of the scenes in this journey, a text-driven point cloud generation pipeline to make a compelling and coherent sequence of 3D scenes, and a large VLM to verify the generated scenes. We show compelling, diverse visual results across various scene types and styles, forming imaginary "wonderjourneys". Project website: https://kovenyu.com/WonderJourney/

notes: Native standard-runner recipes own SD2/Marigold diffusion; no upstream checkout, Diffusers pipeline, Flask server, or PyTorch3D extension is required.
The single RGB image is resized to 512x512. Each optional camera matrix requests one new world view, starting from an identity seed camera.
Camera paths use row-major OpenCV world-to-camera matrices; named upstream viewer matrices use column-major 16-vectors.
Exported scene depth equals Marigold scene depth times 1000; camera translations use these exported units.
Guided depth uses the final eight Euler steps and known scene/ground anchors; latent noise and U-Net input remain unscaled as in the pinned source.
gsplat supplies differentiable projections and sorted tile lists; native Triton RGB/alpha and median depth share alpha cap 0.99 and retain the surface crossing the termination threshold.
Fitting uses 0.8 L1 plus 0.2 DSSIM. Integration contracts and numerical comparison are separate from scene-quality observations; full official pipeline parity remains pending.
New Gaussians precede the frozen scene at equal depth; only their bounded particle range is fitted and pruned.
Upstream reports 48 GB VRAM. Local component weights and a CUDA-compatible gsplat installation are required.
No separate WonderWorld generator checkpoint is needed. SD2 uses CreativeML Open RAIL++-M; retain all component licensing terms.
Uses the unified WorldFoundry GPU environment and an ABI-compatible gsplat build.
All inference orchestration is in-tree; no external checkout, PyTorch3D, Flask server, or OpenAI credential is needed.

paper.title: WonderWorld: Interactive 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image
paper.abstract: We present WonderWorld, a novel framework for interactive 3D scene generation that enables users to interactively specify scene contents and layout and see the created scenes in low latency. The major challenge lies in achieving fast generation of 3D scenes. Existing scene generation approaches fall short of speed as they often require (1) progressively generating many views and depth maps, and (2) time-consuming optimization of the scene geometry representations. We introduce the Fast Layered Gaussian Surfels (FLAGS) as our scene representation and an algorithm to generate it from a single view. Our approach does not need multiple views, and it leverages a geometry-based initialization that significantly reduces optimization time. recipes.name: Causal-rCM
recipes.summary: Causal-rCM applies NVIDIA's rCM consistency distillation to causal video generation: it streams video autoregressively over latent-frame chunks with distilled few-step sampling, making it a low-latency interactive world-model candidate. Wo…

notes: Causal-rCM generates autoregressively over latent-frame chunks. first_chunk_t and chunk_t select the schedule; the c1-1 frame-wise setting gives the lowest streaming latency and c3-3 more throughput.
The released causal entrypoint is prompt and image conditioned. It exposes no discrete action space, so the input schema declares no actions; the chunk schedule is the streaming control surface.
Distilled few-step sampling is the default (`distilled=True`, 4 steps, mid_t 15/16 5/6 5/8). Setting distilled=False samples the multi-step causal-diffusion teacher with CFG instead.
Setting context_from_last_step=True caches the final denoising forward as the next chunk's context, saving one clean forward pass per chunk. Use it only with a checkpoint trained for noisy context.

Set kv_cache_policy=sliding_window to cap the causal cache at kv_cache_window_blocks (with optional kv_cache_sink_blocks) and allocate only the retained prefix plus one in-flight chunk. The default keep_all policy reproduces the upstream unbounded cache bit-for-bit. RoPE-remapping cache policies stay out of this post-RoPE entrypoint and require the separate extrapolation path.
The upstream imaginaire package is not vendored. WorldFoundry's lazy_config, easy_io, rank-aware logging, and selective activation checkpointing back the vendored runtime instead.
Covers only the vendored causal inference path. Upstream's training extras (megatron-core, transformer_engine, wandb, webdataset, fvcore, hydra-core) are intentionally omitted.

Set kv_cache_policy=sliding_window to cap the causal cache at kv_cache_window_blocks (with optional kv_cache_sink_blocks) and allocate only the retained prefix plus one in-flight chunk. The default keep_all policy reproduces the upstream unbounded cache bit-for-bit. RoPE-remapping cache policies stay out of this post-RoPE entrypoint and require the separate extrapolation path.

overview: Causal-rCM applies NVIDIA's rCM consistency distillation to causal video generation: it streams video autoregressively over latent-frame chunks with distilled few-step sampling, making it a low-latency interactive world-model candidate. WorldFoundry runs the official Apache-2.0 causal inference stack.
overviewZh: Causal-rCM 把英伟达的 rCM 一致性蒸馏应用于因果视频生成：以潜帧 chunk 为单位自回归流式生成，配合蒸馏的少步采样，是低延迟交互式世界模型的候选。WorldFoundry 运行官方 Apache-2.0 因果推理栈。
architecture: Per the paper (arXiv 2510.08431), rCM adds score regularization to continuous-time consistency distillation for few-step sampling. The causal variant denoises latent-frame chunks under a block-causal attention mask; its masks and chunk schedules match upstream.
architectureZh: 按论文（arXiv 2510.08431），rCM 在连续时间一致性蒸馏中加入分数正则化，实现少步采样。因果版本在块因果注意力掩码下逐 chunk 去噪潜帧；其掩码与 chunk 调度与上游一致。
usageNotes: first_chunk_t and chunk_t select the schedule: c1-1 frame-wise gives the lowest streaming latency, c3-3 more throughput. Distilled 4-step sampling is the default; distilled=False samples the multi-step teacher with CFG. context_from_last_step=True saves one clean forward per chunk but requires a checkpoint trained for noisy context. The released entrypoint is prompt/image conditioned with no discrete action space.
usageNotesZh: first_chunk_t 与 chunk_t 选择调度：c1-1 逐帧模式流式延迟最低，c3-3 吞吐更高。默认使用蒸馏的 4 步采样；distilled=False 则以 CFG 采样多步教师。context_from_last_step=True 每 chunk 省一次干净前向，但要求 checkpoint 针对带噪上下文训练。发布的入口为提示词/图像条件，无离散动作空间。

paper.title: Large Scale Diffusion Distillation via Score-Regularized Continuous-Time Consistency
paper.abstract: Although continuous-time consistency models (e.g., sCM, MeanFlow) are theoretically principled and empirically powerful for fast academic-scale diffusion, its applicability to large-scale text-to-image and video tasks remains unclear due to infrastructure challenges in Jacobian-vector product (JVP) computation and the limitations of evaluation benchmarks like FID. This work represents the first effort to scale up continuous-time consistency to general application-level image and video diffusion models, and to make JVP-based distillation effective at large scale. We first develop a parallelism-compatible FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel, enabling sCM training on models with over 10 billion parameters and high-dimensional video tasks. Our investigation reveals fundamental quality limitations of sCM in fine-detail generation, which we attribute to error accumulation and the "mode-covering" natur

paper.title: Dexora: Open-source VLA for High-DoF Bimanual Dexterity
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently become a central direction in embodied AI, but current systems are restricted to either dual-gripper control or single-arm dexterous hand manipulation. While low-dimensional gripper control can often be handled with simpler methods, high-dimensional dexterous hand control benefits greatly from full end-to-end VLA learning. In this work, we introduce Dexora, the first open-source VLA system that natively targets dual-arm, dual-hand high-DoF manipulation. We design a hybrid teleoperation pipeline that decouples gross arm kinematics (captured with a custom exoskeleton backpack) from fine finger motion (markerless hand tracking via Apple Vision Pro), and that drives both a physical dual-arm dual-hand platform and an identical MuJoCo digital twin. Using that interface, we assemble a large training corpus: an embodiment-matched synthetic corpus
